verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own documented zero-retention policy says inputs, outputs and user data stay private, and dedicated private-endpoint instances offer data isolation. Together these strongly imply customer data is not used for training, but no evidence explicitly states a no-training commitment. missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is never used to train models, detailed privacy/data-usage policy documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: With our zero retention policy your inputs, your outputs, and your user data stay private.
require data isolation? Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint
